integrity: Mathematical argument and independent finite exhaustive computational cross-checks are included. General asymptotics rest on proof, not numerical data; originality is based on inspected literature with residual priority risk. Independent mathematical validation and external priority review have not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact counts apply to the explicitly defined non-Lie Leibniz algebra with bracket [e_2,e_1]=e_1 over every finite field. Asymptotics are for fixed field order and increasing abelian summand dimension. General Leibniz algebras, other nonnilpotent families and field-varying limits are not classified. The prior full classification used as motivation assumes characteristic different from two; the present theorem for the displayed algebra holds also in characteristic two.
title: Idempotent endomorphism rank spectrum and two-hyperplane law for a solvable Leibniz algebra
